blocks.text: Requests for elevated system access (admin or root privileges) require approval from both the requestor's direct manager and the Security team before IT may grant access.
Manager approval and Security team review are conducted in parallel. IT grants access only after both approvals are received.
Elevated access is granted for a maximum period of 90 days. If continued access is required beyond 90 days, the requestor must submit a new access request.

In the event of a P0 incident, Security may grant emergency elevated access without prior manager approval. The requestor's manager must provide retroactive approval within 24 hours of the emergency grant.
